raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
The coding-agent README pins MiMo data from before the upstream removal of 96 code tasks. Following its full-data conversion still emits `format-code-task-000484`, whose mapped image returns `404 MANIFEST_UNKNOWN`, so image preparation stops. The converter follows the official mapping correctly.

Update the example to the fixed revision `e8e81e4945270b6212204bad99de1e598f7fb077`, use the same revision for both source files, and correct the task/row counts. Document regeneration in a fresh revision-specific `DATA_ROOT` and add a one-task data/image preparation smoke check with separate outputs. The fresh directory also avoids reusing old completed OCI bundles: a dataset SHA does not pin the contents of Docker tags.

Related to #2477.

### Data verification

Compared both complete `code.parquet` and `image-mapping.jsonl` snapshots and ran the existing `prepare_mimo.py --agents codex claude_code` CLI on each, using slime base `540ea919e45b8b929198abce008a103be9cfc779`:

| Dataset revision | Code tasks | Mapping entries | Converted rows |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `639865fd3374018d6cb29b9fb82dd531406fcf5f` | 2698 | 3764 | 5396 |
| `e8e81e4945270b6212204bad99de1e598f7fb077` | 2602 | 3668 | 5204 |

- The 96 deleted task-image keys exactly match the 96 deleted mapping keys, with no additions.
- All 2602 retained full Parquet records and their mappings are unchanged; all 5204 retained converter output rows are identical.
- Every output's instance ID, image and working directory match its source data, with one row per requested agent. `000484` is removed; `000723` remains.
- The existing E2E pin is intentionally unchanged: it selects only `000003` and `000045`, which remain identical, and pairs them with fixed image digests. This PR changes the full-data example, not that historical test baseline.

The [upstream history](https://huggingface.co/datasets/XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-RL-oss/commits/main) records the coordinated task/mapping deletion. The [pinned data card](https://huggingface.co/datasets/XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-RL-oss/blob/e8e81e4945270b6212204bad99de1e598f7fb077/README.md) also notes the October 19 image update, motivating the fresh-cache instruction.

### Validation

- `python -m pytest tests/test_agent/test_e2e_asset_cache.py -k mimo`: 3 passed, covering deduplication/cache reuse, colliding tags, and OCI preparation without unpacking (Python 3.12.14, macOS).
- The documented smoke conversion emits two rows and one image for `000723`; all four preparation shell blocks pass `bash -n`.
- Registry checks on 2026-11-01: all **2602/2602** unique code-image references from the new real converter output returned `200` to manifest HEAD requests, each with a digest (03:31–03:45 UTC). Separate GET checks confirm `000484` returns `404 MANIFEST_UNKNOWN`, while `000723` and `arvo-v1-10055` return `200`.
- The actual `prepare_sunabako_images.py --format oci` imported `000723` using Sunabako 0.1.2's unmodified Python source from its official sdist and skopeo 1.22.0 on macOS. Downloaded the complete **3,036,994,528-byte** compressed layer and independently verified manifest/config/layer SHA-256 and sizes. Re-running with the documented two-row smoke input succeeded with one image-map entry and unchanged bundle files. Manifest digest: `sha256:e6656ecb9a982264a315f43c3a9ce33396acc01b0b1294b9fff74f425b201a24`.
- `git diff --check` and `pre-commit run --files examples/coding_agent_rl/README.md --show-diff-on-failure` passed (the non-applicable hooks skipped).

No sandbox launch, agent execution, full-dataset layer download, or RL training was run. Manifest availability is a point-in-time check, and retained Docker tags can still change upstream. No converter, downloader, reward, or training behavior is changed.

<details>
<summary>Reproduce the data conversion counts</summary>

Run from the checkout with the example dependencies installed:

```bash
for revision in \
  639865fd3374018d6cb29b9fb82dd531406fcf5f \
  e8e81e4945270b6212204bad99de1e598f7fb077; do
  hf download XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-RL-oss code.parquet image-mapping.jsonl \
    --repo-type dataset --revision "$revision" --local-dir "/tmp/mimo-$revision/data"
  python examples/coding_agent_rl/prepare_mimo.py \
    --data "/tmp/mimo-$revision/data" --output "/tmp/mimo-$revision/train-mixed.jsonl" \
    --agents codex claude_code
done
```

The CLI reports `5396` rows / `2698` tasks for the old revision and `5204` rows / `2602` tasks for the new revision. For the representative import, run the README's smoke commands with the new snapshot.

</details>

+removed 96 tasks and their image mappings.
